said it plans to spend ~$250M in Arizona to build, own, and operate new gas supply infrastructure for the unnamed customer's semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging operations, including new PRISM hydrogen generation units; carbon dioxide purification units; bulk gas systems for helium, hydrogen, and carbon dioxide; and associated storage, purification, analytical equipment, and pipeline infrastructure.
The company said the latest contract marks its second recent semiconductor manufacturing supply win, raising combined capital commitments to more than $900M across the two projects.
